dimensions.assessment: Affects NOAA administrators, participants in program training, and coastal management entities.
Changes are administrative and programmatic, extending an existing federal program and clarifying data availability.
The source does not specify particular dollar amounts or appropriations.
Amends the Digital Coast Act to adjust data requirements, restrict training types, and extend the sunset date.
